split: Retain original 464 training queries. Exclude ALL 575 v1 queries from new validation/test. Sort unused triple identities by SHA256('v2:'+id), first 96 validation, next 192 test. No test scoring until all model checkpoints are selected.
selection: Choose checkpoint by new validation reference objective, including iteration zero. Freeze each before test. No seed selection. Production policy is unchanged.
teacher: Exact subset optimizer is used ONLY on training queries for oracle variants. Greedy teacher for stable variants. Select any allowed member of teacher set; retain audited fallback if none available. Teacher labels are computational, not expert prescriptions.
scoring: Same v1 full reference graph and objective for all methods. Score raw selection and shared deterministic delete/add/swap postprocessing separately. No reward-weight tuning.
baseline: Greedy, greedy plus identical local search, exact set optimum, and frozen v1 RBF/PPO per seed. Exact test optimum is an evaluation ceiling, never a training label.
paper_metrics: Report Jaccard target consistency both on 49 shared targets and on ALL eligible target IDs in the retrieved bundle; associations are not predicted affinity. Retain per-query herb count and PPI coverage. Pathway enrichment is a separate public-database experiment, not clinical replication.
limits: Shared knowledge graph across all queries
Model and evidence-drop generalization are different tasks
Improvements are not assumed; all variants and seeds published
No reuse of new test results for tuning this version
